name: Shenzhen JLC Technology Group Co., Ltd
summary: Shenzhen JLC Technology Group Co., Ltd manufactures and sells printed circuit boards (PCBs) in China, Europe, Asia, North America, and internationally. The company offers PCBs, including multi-layer, high-frequency, and copper and aluminum substrate boards; flexible printed circuits (FPC); and electronic components. Its services comprising PCB prototyping and manufacturing, surface mount technology (SMT) assembly, 3D printing, CNC machining, laser stencils, precision sheet metal, fabrication and assembly, heating elements, and the production of nano laser and stepped steel mesh.
